name: Grapnel Launcher
effect:
The Grapnel Launcher has a medium range of 30 metres, and can be fired as a Combat Action like a normal Ranged Weapon into any surface with a default DN of 3. If successfully fired into a surface, the grapnel latches on, and can be retracted to pull you up to that surface as a Free Action.

A simple tool utilised by many strike teams, a Grapnel Launcher can quietly pull the full weight of a Primaris Astartes to an advantageous vertical position in seconds.
note: Differs from fspg-grapnel-launcher: Keywords print ASTRA MILITARUM where it prints ADEPTUS ASTARTES, and the flavour paragraph is added. Rules text, Value 4 and Rarity 1 (Uncommon) match. Not voa-grapnel-launcher (a weapon profile).

name: Krak Satchel
effect: Little more than a bag filled with Krak and Frag grenades linked by a single trigger, Krak Satchels are thrown together by desperate Astra Militarum operatives faced with something simple explosives can't destroy.
note: Printed Rarity 3 = Very Rare (Core p.206 DN penalty). Range printed "(S) metres", read as thrown x1 (S metres); table row is under the DEMO CHARGE heading.

name: Breaching Ladder
effect: These simple, handmade steel ladders are three metres long and designed to help Astra Militarum soldiers scale wreckage or barricades to advance on their target. You can use a Breaching Ladder to walk over a gap of three metres or less, or aid in climbing as described on page 180 of Wrath & Glory.

name: Smoke Grenades
effect: A Smoke Grenade fills a Blast (9) area with thick white smoke until the end of the fourth Round after it is detonated, dramatically reducing visibility in the area and imposing a +3 DN penalty to Ballistic Skill and Awareness Tests, and a +2 DN penalty to melee attack Tests.
note: Differs from apoc-smoke-grenades: Blast (9) not Blast (10) and no Gas; Value 2 not 4, Keywords EXPLOSIVE, IMPERIUM. Damage printed "—" (stored 0/0). Range "(S) x4m or as Launcher" read as thrown x4. Printed Rarity 1 = Uncommon.

name: Multi-laser
note: Printed Rarity 2 = Rare. ED printed "+4", AP "—". A Chimera turret weapon (pp.6, 21).

name: Lasgun Array
note: Printed Rarity 2 = Rare. ED printed "+2", AP "—". Chimera hull lasguns (p.21).

name: Frag Bomb
note: Differs from fspg-frag-bomb: damage 6 ED 3 (it 12/4), thrown x4 (it x2), Blast (4) (it Blast (8)), Value 1 (it 5), Rarity 1 Uncommon (same). Range "(S) x4m or as Launcher"; AP "—".
